data.description: tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh fails 6/7 locally: test_verifier_exits_0_for_large_all_provenanced_diff, test_e2e_large_provenanced_pr_runner_never_invoked, test_e2e_large_provenanced_pr_emits_skipped_conclusion, test_e2e_output_contains_covered_by_sub_pr_reviews_with_list, test_e2e_mixed_diff_invokes_runner. Confirmed PRE-EXISTING (identical failures with the pre-W2 dispatcher at HEAD 2fe97cdf47) — NOT a regression from the W2a net-end-state diff change. Root area is verify-session-provenance.sh behavior on the large all-provenanced fixture (exits non-0 / emits unprovenanced-shas.txt when it should exit 0). Discovered during workflow-stability W2a implementation. Needs investigation: is this a local-env artifact (git/origin setup) or a genuine verifier bug?
data.title: test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh: 6 pre-existing failures in all-provenanced verifier fixture
